cells.gaps: No regulation made under the Act has been found (S.I. 4 of 2025 only commences the Act), so regulations are empty; no published count of decisions for a stated period, so application is not `reported`.
cells.note: Data Protection Act No. 18 of 2024 is in force from 14 January 2025, and the 17 July 2026 enforcement notice against DPSM is a dated decision on a named controller, with the Commission acting, so stage 4. Stage 5 needs issued regulations and a reported year's count, and neither is held.
